1. Mr. B.D. Pande and Mr. Rakshit Joshi, 
learned counsel for the revisionists and Mr. 
Siddhartha Singh, learned counsel for the 
respondents. 
2. Learned counsel for the respondents 
submits that the revisionists have filed 
additional written statement after the 
amendment application was allowed by the 
learned trial court. He submits that the 
documentary proof, if any, with regard to 
the said submission shall be placed before 
this Court on 31.10.2026.
3. List this case on 31.10.2026, after fresh 
cases.

extended till the next date of listing.

1. Mr. B.D. Pande & Mr. Rakshit Joshi, 
learned counsel for the revisionists and Mr. 
Siddhartha Singh, learned counsel for the 
respondents.
2. Yesterday, a statement was given by 
the learned counsel for the respondents that 
the revisionists have filed an additional 
written statement. However, today, the
learned counsel for the respondents fairly 
submits that the said statement was given 
due to misconception, and no additional 
written statement has been filed by the 
revisionists. The said statement is placed on 
record. 
3. List on 20.11.2026.

extended till the next date of listing.
